name: Materials Data Facility (MDF)
scope: Search deposited materials datasets, metadata and properties. Access and licenses vary by deposit.

name: Foundry-ML
scope: Discover structured, schema-described ML datasets within the MDF ecosystem; use the supported client to inspect and load data.

name: Materials Cloud OPTIMADE Client
scope: Select a provider and child database, filter crystal structures, and inspect or download results.

name: OPTIMADE provider registry
scope: Find provider index APIs and discover child structure databases; listing does not guarantee endpoint availability.

name: NIST REMI
scope: Discover materials informatics resources and example datasets; a resource guide rather than a uniform property database.

name: OpenAlex
scope: Find dataset papers and follow references/citations. Scholarly works are discovery leads, not materials-data payloads.

name: NIMS Materials Data Repository (MDR)
scope: Research data and publications with materials-specific metadata, including SuperCon, phonon and spectroscopy collections. Distinct from NIST MDR.

name: Materials Commons
scope: Collaborative research-data storage, metadata, versioning and publication with DOI assignment. Public datasets and private workspaces have different permissions.

name: MPContribs
scope: Community-contributed experimental and computational projects linked to Materials Project materials or compositions. Selected hosted projects are already cataloged.

name: Physical Sciences Data Infrastructure (PSDI)
scope: Federated discovery and community collections across physical sciences. Its index links multiple child services; metadata counts are not independent crystal counts.

name: NIST PhaseData
scope: Phase-based experimental and computational materials data, including diffusion, transition temperatures and composition-dependent properties; also indexes historical diffusion literature.
